purpose: Independently validate an exact CapabilityState transition for autonomous evidence retrieval.
completeness_rule: All required evidence classes and source IDs must be present; absence is INCOMPLETE and conflicting evidence is CONTRADICTORY.
blindness_rule: Ignore Reality verdict, confidence, reasoning, authority flags and self-certification assertions.
independence_rule: Witness executes outside Reality runtime and its verdict is not accepted from Reality as authority.
mutation_rule: Witness cannot modify Reality or authorize external actions.
